subject: SageClinic: eval scoping, scoring draft, and dataset format
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Ella Summers <ella.summers@sageclinic.health>; Dr. Peter Cole <peter.cole@sageclinic.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Kickoff — quick recap + next steps (dataset + scoring)

Hi Ella / Peter — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can scope a short pilot eval on Redwood: 

1) Objective: validate model fit for clinician note summarization and triage suggestions (precision on safety-critical labels: "urgent", "follow-up", "routine").
2) Data we need from you: a 100–500 row sample (de-identified is fine) with columns: note_id, raw_text, clinician_label, desired_summary_length. I attached a small template (redwood_eval_template.csv) — please use that format if possible.
3) Scoring priorities: safety label precision (weight 50%), clinical factuality / hallucination checks (30%), summary brevity / style (20%). Draft rubric attached in follow-up.
4) Recommended starting model(s): Llama-2-13B (8-bit) for best throughput/cost balance and an instruction-tuned 7B variant for a lower-cost control. We can test a quantized 4-bit variant if you care most about latency.
5) Logistics: we can run the eval on Hosted Redwood (fastest) or on your Private instance (if you prefer VPC/SOC2). For Hosted, we'll need a short DPA + data handling confirmation; for Private, we'll exchange deployment specs.

Next steps I recommend: 
- Ella: share the 100-row sample (or S3 link) and any PII constraints by EOD Thursday.
- Redwood: Marissa will draft a scoring matrix and bench harness; Ben will share the prompt bank and Drive link.

Attachment: redwood_eval_template.csv (CSV template — 6 columns, header row).

If you're OK with that plan I can slot a 30-minute kickoff to lock the data handoff and schedule the run.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri*om.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

From: Ella Summers <ella.summers@sageclinic.health>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Dr. Peter Cole <peter.cole@sageclinic.health>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 12:38:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Kickoff — quick recap + next steps (dataset + scoring)

Priyom / Marissa / Ben — great call earlier, thanks. A few clarifications from our side before we hand over data: 

- The dataset: we can provide a 100-row sample this afternoon. It will include clinician notes (free text), a clinician_label (one of: urgent, follow-up, routine), and a short physician summary field (our internal gold). We will strip direct patient identifiers but there may be dated timestamps.
- PII / PHI: we need assurance on retention policy for hosted runs (how long Redwood keeps samples). Can you share current retention defaults? Also, does Redwood support customer-supplied KMS in Private mode?
- Scoring: the safety label precision is our highest priority. We also want an error taxonomy for false positives that we can review (e.g., labeling "urgent" when it was a scheduled follow-up).
- Prompt bank: we'd like examples aimed at reducing overtriage. Can you share a small starter prompt set?

Attached is a 100-row sample we exported (sage_sample_100_rows.csv). It's de-identified but contains clinical abbreviations. We'll follow up with an S3 link for the full pilot dataset if the initial pass looks good.

Thanks,
Ella Summers
Director, Clinical Innovation | SageClinic
ella.summers@sageclinic.health
Attachment: sage_sample_100_rows.csv (100 rows, notes truncated)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ella Summers <ella.summers@sageclinic.health>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff — quick recap + next steps (dataset + scoring)

Hi Ella — thanks for the sample and the questions. Below is a short, pragmatic plan and a first-pass scoring matrix attached (scoring_matrix_v1.csv).

1) Retention & KMS: Hosted default is 30 days retention for pilot artifacts, but we can request a shorter TTL for datasets used solely for eval. For customers on Private we support customer-managed KMS; for Hosted we offer ephemeral encryption keys and can discuss a DPA clause. I'll loop security if you want an official statement.

2) Dataset format: your sample looks good. Two small asks to speed evaluation: please include a consistent timestamp format (ISO-8601 in an event_timestamp column) and a small mapping file for common abbreviations (e.g., "SOB" -> "shortness of breath"). Not mandatory, but it improves scorer consistency.

3) Scoring matrix (draft highlights):
   - Label precision (urgent): binary TP/FP/FN, weighted 0.5. We'll compute precision@1 for "urgent" class.
   - Clinical factuality checks: we will sample 20% of rows for human adjudication and compute a hallucination score (0–3). Weight 0.3.
   - Summary style: BLEU + a brevity penalty for exceeding desired_summary_length; weight 0.2.

4) Prompts: Ben has prepared a starter prompt bank focused on conservative triage wording (attached link below). We'll include variants that force the model to ask clarifying questions vs. making definitive triage calls. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-eval-benchmarks

5) Models & config: for an initial run we recommend:
   - baseline: instruction-tuned 7B (low cost control)
   - primary: Llama-2-13B quantized (8-bit) — balance of quality/latency
   - optional: 13B 4-bit quant for latency-sensitive bursts

6) Timeline: if we get the S3 link by Friday, we can run a 48-hour smoke eval and return a short report by Tuesday. Otherwise, we can do a smaller hosted run on your sample by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: scoring_matrix_v1.csv (CSV with metric calc columns). HubSpot: hubspot:deal/8731.

Let us know if you want Redwood security to join a call — happy to schedule.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Ella Summers <ella.summers@sageclinic.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Kickoff — quick recap + next steps (dataset + scoring)

Marissa / Team — thanks, that all sounds good. We will: 
- Share an S3 link (read-only) with the 2k-row pilot bundle by close of day Friday.
- Include an abbreviation mapping and the ISO timestamps.
- Confirm whether we want Hosted with a 7-day retention or Private demo (checking with IT).

Can we tentatively schedule the smoke-run kickoff for Monday 18 Apr at 10:00 am ET? If Hosted run finishes in ~48 hours, a report on Wednesday would be great.

Also please add a short note in the report flagging any systemic overtriage patterns found (we will triage those programmatically).

Thanks again — Ella
Director, Clinical Innovation | SageClinic
ella.summers@sageclinic.health
